title: Reliability Review — Cross-Agent Consistency Verification
methodology: Read-only cross-validation. All agent JSON outputs read. Raw-file grep verification performed for certified/archived/QID counts per AGENTS.md §5 (dual cross-check requirement). Spot-checked QID-level discrepancies via direct Select-String on pack_a_corrected.js.

cross_checks.note: Unanimous across all 7 sources + independent raw-file grep. Count stable across S301, S700, S800, S801, S802.
Agent E reports only Pack A (19), consistent with Agent B's Pack A count. Macro count unanimous. However, Agent P's QID-level lists contain 5 errors (see discrepancies).
All 5 packs at 500 QIDs each. Zero file corruption.

Pack-level: Gold=B, Silver=A+E, Bronze=C+D is stable across S800 and S802. Agent I internally reports 'NO TIER CHANGES.' S801 uses per-section granularity (4-tier: Gold/Silver/Bronze/Thin/Archive) which is a refinement, not a contradiction. S801 places Pack E sections in 'Thin' tier, which aligns with Agent I's Pack E 'educational thinness' findings despite the Silver governance label.

discrepancies.metric: Agent I section labeling internal inconsistency (Pack A)
discrepancies.inconsistency: Agent I lists Pack A sections_fully_certified as ['A', 'D', 'E']. But A has 73/75 (97.3% — not fully) and E has 58/75 (77.3% — not fully). Agent I lists 'F (75/75)' as partial but 75/75 should be fully certified.
discrepancies.root_cause: Labeling error within the JSON structure — the numeric counts are correct, but the 'fully certified' and 'partial' labels are swapped or incorrectly assigned.
discrepancies.resolution: Ignore Agent I's section labels for Pack A. Use Agent O's section matrix (independently verified via raw grep) as the authoritative per-section certification state.

discrepancies.metric: Pack E EC under-50 count: Agent I (23) vs Agent T (24)
discrepancies.root_cause: Likely a boundary-condition difference: Agent T says 'below 50 chars' (strict less-than), Agent I says 'under 50' (possibly ≤49 vs <50). One item may be exactly 50 chars. Both agents agree 90.6% of Pack E EC fields are under 100 chars.
discrepancies.resolution: Negligible. Both figures confirm Pack E's educational thinness. No action needed.
